COMMENT: Per-(hat x species) fit registry — single source of truth. gen-hatfits.mjs emits HatFits.luau for the client; chef-sheet.mjs reads this file directly, so the review sheets always match the game. Resolution: defaults <- species.default <- species[hatId]. offset is studs in head space (x right, y up, z forward), tilt is degrees [pitch, roll], scale multiplies the skull-width base scale, hideEars hides the Ears group while the hat is worn (the built-in hat always hides).
